name: Air Form
text: This creature can move through any space as narrow as one centimetre.

name: Ambush Predator
text: When this creature hits an enemy that is unaware of them with an attack for the first time during a scene, increase the SL of their attack by one step (max. critical success).

name: Amphibious
text: This creature can hold their breath underwater for a medium duration and can swim with normal Movement.

name: Aquatic
text: This creature is immune to drowning and can swim with normal Movement.

name: Aquatic (fast)
text: This creature is immune to drowning and can swim with normal Movement. Also, this creature can swim with +2 Movement per turn.

name: Beast of Burden
text: This creature can be of large Size even for a Tier that normally doesn’t allow that Size.

name: Blindsight (close)
text: This creature perceives the location of creatures and objects within close range without relying on sight. Full cover blocks this sense.

name: Blindsight (medium)
text: This creature perceives the location of creatures and objects within medium range without relying on sight. Full cover blocks this sense.

name: Burrow
text: This creature can move freely through loose earth, treating it as difficult terrain.

name: Darkvision (medium/long)
text: This creature can see at medium range in absolute darkness as in bright light and up to a long distance as in dim light.

name: Deep Breath
text: This creature can hold their breath underwater for a short duration and can swim with normal Movement.

name: Desert Adapted
text: This creature can ignore the penalty to Supply checks for extremely hot environments.

name: Dive Attack
text: After flying at least a short distance downwards, this creature gains +1 boon on their next attack during the same turn. On a hit, increase the SL by one step (max. critical hit).

name: Earth Glide
text: This creature can burrow through natural earth and stone as part of their normal Movement.

name: Echolocation (medium)
text: This creature perceives the location of creatures and objects within medium range without relying on sight, including around corners and behind full cover. While this creature is deafened, they lose this sense.

name: Fast Movement
text: This creature has +1 Movement and can cover twice the normal distance during travel.

name: Fire Form
text: This creature can move through any space as narrow as a keyhole. This creature is immune against fire damage and burning. This creature illuminates the area in short distance around them in bright light. If this creature is hit by an attack at melee range, the attacker suffers their Tier x 2 fire damage (ignore AV). If this creature comes into contact with a large amount of water, they take 5 damage (ignore AV) each turn doing so.

name: Flying (Wings)
text: This creature can fly with +1 Movement per turn. If on the ground, they can’t use more than 1 Movement per turn.

name: Flying (hover)
text: This creature can fly freely by hovering in the air with +1 Movement per turn.

name: Gore Attack
text: After moving at least a short distance in a straight line, this creature gains +1 boon on their next attack during the same turn. On a hit, increase the SL by one step (max. critical hit).

name: Hard Shell
text: This creature can use the Guard Quick Action treating their shell as a shield.

name: Incorporeal Movement
text: This creature can move through creatures and solid objects as part of their normal Movement. They can't end their Movement inside a creature or a solid object.

name: Intimidating Roar
text: This creature can use an Action in combat to unleash a powerful roar. Roll Strength + Fortitude vs. Resist against each creature within short range. On a success, they are frightened of you. They can roll Spirit + Fortitude at the start of their turns. On a success, they stop being frightened. You can use this ability once per combat.

name: Keen Eyes
text: This creature gains +1 boon on Perception rolls based on sight.

name: Keen Scent
text: This creature gains +1 boon on Perception rolls based on smell. They also sense the presence and general direction of any creature within close range by scent alone, without needing to see them. Still air and full cover block this.

name: Magic Sense (long)
text: This creature can intuitively sense sources of magic within long range.

name: Natural Climber
text: This creature can climb without treating it as difficult terrain.

name: Night Vision
text: This creature can see one range category further from sources of bright and dim light.

name: Pack Tactics
text: While an ally is in melee range of the same target, this creature's attacks against that target gain +1 boon.

name: Pounce
text: If this creature spend Movement towards their target during the turn they attack, they gain +1 boon on the attack. Also on a strong or critical hit against a creature of equal or smaller Size, the target is knocked prone.

name: Powerful Build
text: Add +2 to this creature’s carrying capacity.

name: Relentless
text: When this creature would suffer a Wound, they can choose to ignore it. This creature can use this ability once per day.

name: Rotting Slowness
text: This creature can only move or take an Action per turn, not both. This creature can't use Quick Actions.

name: Shell Defense
text: As a Quick Action, this creature can withdraw into their shell, gaining the effects of the Guard Quick Action and +2 AV but becoming unable to move or attack until they use another Quick Action to emerge.

name: Slow Movement
text: This creature can’t spend more than 1 Movement per turn.

name: Slow Movement (Land)
text: This creature can’t use more than 1 Movement per turn while on land.

name: Small Stature
text: This creature gains +1 boon on Agility rolls to hide or move stealthily.

name: Spider Climb
text: This creature can climb on any surface, even upside down, without rolling.

name: Strong Leap
text: This creature can jump up to a short distance without rolling, even without moving before.

name: Sure-Footed
text: This creature gains +1 boon on rolls to avoid being knocked prone or pushed. They also ignore difficult terrain from rocky or mountainous areas.

name: Swallow
text: This creature can only swallow one smaller creature at a time. When doing so, the target is no longer grappled. Instead, the target becomes blinded and restrained. The target also takes lasting acid damage equal to normal weapon damage. When this creature takes a Wound or dies, they release the swallowed creature and they are spit out prone in melee range.

name: Tool Usage
text: This creature can use simple tools and weapons (only Quality 1) after being trained with them for at least a medium duration.

name: Track Scent
text: This creature can track a scent trail for up to a day after it was made, unless some foreign force influenced the scent (for example, a heavy rain).

name: Trample
text: When this creature moves through the space of a creature at least one Size smaller, they can make a Stomp attack against that creature as a Quick Action.

name: Tremorsense (medium)
text: This creature perceives the location of creatures and objects moving on a surface connected to their own within medium range. Anything not in contact with that surface is unseen.

name: Undead Nature
text: This creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, drink, or sleep.

name: Wall Climb
text: This creature can climb on any vertical surface without rolling.

name: Water Form
text: This creature can move through any space as narrow as one centimetre. If this creature suffers frost damage, they are briefly slowed.

name: Web Walker
text: This creature can move on webs normally. They also know the exact location of any creature touching their web while standing on it.
